title: Nazca Lines made to be seen from the sky

tellings.quote: They only make sense 150 to 500 m in the air, which is far higher than any of the closest vantage points on the ground.

plain: The Nazca Lines, huge figures and lines scratched into the desert ground in Peru, are said to have been made to be seen from the air: Michels says they "only make sense 150 to 500 m in the air, which is far higher than any of the closest vantage points on the ground." He tells this himself, without naming a source, in an episode about strange three-fingered figures found in Peru. If so, it raises the question of who their makers expected to be looking down.
